name: Club Doki Doki
source:
The story is about a guy who moves to a high school in the city, where he meets 3 girls who then form a club with him, Club Doki Doki! With the goal of the club is to have their hearts race, they go on weird and crazy adventures! The player will also have different choices which will influence who they will end up with at the end!

[Edited from itch.io]
translation:
故事讲述一名男子搬到城里的高中，在那里遇见三名女孩，并与她们共同成立“心跳社”！社团的目标是让心跳加速，因此他们展开了古怪疯狂的冒险！玩家还会遇到不同选择，这些选择将影响最终与谁走到一起！

（改编自itch.io）
